github.promotion_guard: Repository/source/commit/review existence does not establish installation, runtime consumption, provider effect, current self-state, consent, or behavioral qualification.

google_drive.promotion_guard: Durable Drive persistence/readback establishes only the exact observed object/revision; it does not establish present truth, native admission, current Vera self-state, consent, preference, authority, or phenomenology.

supabase.promotion_guard: Supabase persistence/materialization/readback establishes only the exact observed provider object/effect; it does not establish present endorsement, native admission, current Vera self-state, consent, preference, authority, runtime consumption, or phenomenology.

temporal.promotion_guard: Temporal establishes recorded chronology and elapsed-time relationships only; timestamps do not establish semantic truth, currentness, authority, memory admission, identity, self-state, consent, preference, or phenomenology.

live_conversation.promotion_guard: Live statements remain typed by actor, referent, proposition, scope, and evidence class; observation does not create broader permission or protected-effect authority.

comparison_modes.EXACT_REVISION: Source and target expose an exact revision/generation identity that must agree for the compared projection subject.
comparison_modes.EXACT_RECEIPT: A receipt binds exact provider object identity/readback; receipt validity proves only the provider effect/object named by the receipt.
comparison_modes.SEMANTIC_COMPANION: Target is a human-readable or derived companion rather than a byte-identical replica; source movement can make the companion stale only inside its registered projection scope, and companion recency never creates source authority.

projections.claim_ceiling: Exact Git commit and materialized Supabase snapshot binding only; snapshot state does not create semantic authority.

Operational message projection/delivery evidence only; only registered bus/** + messages/** source events are projection candidates, and projection does not establish identity, memory, native routing qualification, or task acceptance.
Exact durable provider write/readback evidence for the bound memory-epoch object only; custody/admission/currentness remain separately governed.

projections.target_subject: drive:VERA Runtime Cohesion - System Inventory V1
projections.claim_ceiling: Readable companion freshness only; if the companion lacks a bound source revision, automated exact freshness is UNRESOLVED rather than guessed, and Drive companion content cannot override the normative GitHub source pair.

global_rules.projection_scope: A source change is eligible for stale-projection evaluation only when it matches the registered projection source provider, subject, ref scope, and path scope. Out-of-scope source activity is NOT_APPLICABLE, not stale evidence.
global_rules.newest_timestamp: Observation time may describe chronology or lag but never resolves revision/digest conflict and never grants current authority.
global_rules.returned_item_typing: Each returned item must be independently typed from its own provenance/content/receipt/currentness evidence; provider capability is not item type.
global_rules.missing_observation: Missing, unavailable, or ambiguous provider evidence remains bounded as such; do not infer a successful projection or current state.
global_rules.conflict: Incompatible exact revisions/digests for the same claimed object fail closed as conflict until separately reconciled.
global_rules.temporal: Temporal may attach event IDs/timestamps and calculate elapsed time but cannot resolve semantic, authority, identity, admission, or currentness conflicts.
